# An attribute inside a {{with}} in a start tag is reached when the tests
# render it, so the action in its value is mutated, not skipped as
# unreached.
#
# Each row carries a data-version attribute only when it has a source,
# and the test reads that attribute back, so it catches the mutant that
# zeroes the version. The coverage pre-pass once counted no attribute
# inside a branch in a start tag, reported that mutant as one no test
# reaches, and skipped it.

muxt test-template-mutations -v --seed 1
cmp stdout want.txt
! stdout 'no test reaches'
! stderr 'warning:'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.27
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "rows"}}<table><tbody>{{range .}}<tr {{with .Source}}data-version='{{.Version}}'{{end}}><td>{{.State}}</td></tr>{{end}}</tbody></table>{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Source struct {
	Version int
}

type Row struct {
	State  string
	Source *Source
}

func Render(w io.Writer, rows []Row) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "rows", rows)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// applied matches the first row whichever quotes the attribute is
// written with.
var applied = regexp.MustCompile(`<tr data-version=["']3["']><td>applied</td></tr>`)

func TestRows(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, []Row{{State: "applied", Source: &Source{Version: 3}}, {State: "pending"}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := buf.String(); !applied.MatchString(got) {
		t.Errorf("rows = %q, want a row with data-version 3", got)
	}
}
